profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer iOS at Varo Bank
profile.summary:
•Swift UI development with Apollo client integration , using combine framework 	
- Proven solid experience in Android & iOS application architect, design and implementation.  User-friendly design, improving and documenting code, continuous integration, deployment, unit testing, and acceptance based testing
•	Experienced with Android native mobile application using Android SDK for over 2 years including working with fragments, activity lifecycle, and ANR
•	Experienced in XML and JSON based web requests, multithreading, and parsing using both 1st party and 3rd party frameworks such as, NSXMLParser and NSJSONSerialization
•	Performed extensive research and deployed knowledge application for app release processes to social media platforms – ie. Google Play/The App Store
•	Working knowledge of various frameworks including: UIKit, OpenGL, MapKit, and Core Location 
•	Efficient storage of data using File System, Core Data and SQLite
•	Well versed with UI design implementation using both Storyboards and NIB files
•	Experienced in Agile SCRUM and TDD methodologies with projects
•	Implemented application designs based on MVC and Singleton architecture
•	Worked with various departments in projects to effectively develop applications
•	Managed various team sizes to ensure features were always completed on time

positions.title: Design Integrator
positions.description:
•	Recreating design layouts from design redlines
•	Pixel perfect accuracy in building grid, margins, gutters, padding.
•	Font and font margins/padding, weights, and text box dynamics
•	Using pre-defined color palettes and checking against for design consistency.
•	Ingesting and placing/replacing icons within boundary boxes.
•	Replacing debug UI with new layouts and relinking code behind.
•	Creating dynamic (input based such as scrolling) animations as elegant and beautiful keyframed animations.
•	Rendering charts with Shinobicharts and specific designe on charts
•	Fixing bugs a UI level in code with the Engineering team 
•	Communication between the Design and Engineering team 
•	Designed the architecture according to the requirements and the business 
•	Designed of the plan working and the time of delivery with Agile environment
•	Catch possible bugs on the application design according with the specifications of the application 
•	Animations on UIViewcontrollers and UIViews
•	Creation of customize widgets (UIButtons, UINavigationControllers, etc.)
